title: Patrick AFB helicopter flies out to the light

tellings.quote:
we see one of the
helicopters from the Air Force base go
out to it.

plain: Off Cocoa Beach, Florida, in 2013, a helicopter from Patrick Air Force Base, a nearby US Air Force base, flew out toward a strange light the witnesses were watching. Charles Buhler, a NASA engineer who says he saw it himself, tells it. To him the helicopter going out to it shows the military also noticed the light and took it seriously.
